notes: Identity verified from supplied text: title Why People Are Reluctant to Tempt Fate; Jane L. Risen and Thomas Gilovich; Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2008, Vol. 95, No. 2, 293–307; DOI 10.1037/0022-3514.95.2.293. This is a full primary article text with methods, results and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF path was supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields examined; other fields are unassigned placeholders. The target is explicitly the no-load comparison between imagining not having done versus having done the reading. The printed t is retained; the same test additionally prints d = 0.58. Final overall N = 120 is not the target subgroup N. A candidate no-load N of 60 follows from 120 / 4 = 30 per condition, then 30 + 30 = 60; this involves deriving unprinted cell counts and is withheld under the requirement to sum explicit printed final-group counts. N was not inferred from df.
